source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Accepted spaces.update copies only updatedTabProperties.url. The native toolbar likewise changes only its stored URL and leaves a TODO to reload/reopen the existing tab. Current creation converts cookieStoreId and linkHandler, but that does not prove update changes those settings. Tests inspected here verify creation/container IDs and basic URL updates, not all non-URL update fields. Keep this limit in API maintenance and reviews. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: State the limited current effect of a space tab update
